title: Star
description: Draw a white five-pointed star with one point straight up on a black background. The tips are 0.8 from the center and the inner corners are 0.32 from the center. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 in both directions.
hintText: Fold the angle with mod() so all five points land in one narrow wedge, and rebuild the pixel position inside that wedge. Then you only need the distance to one edge, from a tip to the nearest inner corner. Use atan(uv.x, uv.y) so angle 0 points up.
